description: This file defines the PartitionEndpointProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for providing and managing partition-specific endpoint configurations and logic for AWS services.

classes.name: PartitionEndpointProvider
classes.description: Provider class for AWS endpoint partitions, capable of retrieving partitions by region or name, and managing default and custom providers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with given partitions, default partition, and options.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the object to be called as a function to resolve endpoints based on region and service.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate partition matching the region and service, or returns the default.

methods.name: getPartitionByName
methods.description: Finds a partition by its name.

properties.name: partitions
properties.description: Array of Partition objects representing the AWS partitions.

properties.name: defaultPartition
properties.description: String identifier for the default partition.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default partition endpoint provider with preloaded endpoint data.

methods.name: mergePrefixData
methods.description: Merges prefix-specific endpoint data into the main partition data.
